spanish: Y no tomarán rescate al huir a ciudad de su refugio, para volver a habitar en la tierra hasta muerte del sacerdote.

findings.issue: לָנוּס is only ל plus qal infinitive construct, so purpose or complement stays open. 'al huir' locks a temporal circumstance (upon fleeing) and can make the 2mp of תִקְחוּ the ones who flee.

notes: The other tokens match, including tomarán as ustedes and ciudad de su refugio for the construct plus 3ms suffix.
